NO/03 — WATERMARK GUIDE

One free AI watermark remover for text and image metadata.

NoMark combines an AI text watermark remover, invisible character checker and AI image metadata remover in one private web app. There is no sign-up, and the exact scanner shows what changed before you copy or download the result.

TEXT / 01

ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini watermark remover

Clean pasted AI text from supported hidden characters, suspicious formatting and statistical token patterns while preserving visible meaning and protected facts.

UNICODE / 02

Invisible Unicode & zero-width character remover

Find zero-width spaces, word joiners, Unicode tags, bidirectional controls and mixed-script lookalikes with an inspectable character report.

IMAGE / 03

AI metadata, EXIF & C2PA remover

Strip common EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC and C2PA Content Credentials from JPEG, PNG and WebP images through local browser processing.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What NoMark removes — and what it does not.

How do I remove hidden watermarks from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini text?

Paste the text into NoMark, review the character report, then choose Remove AI watermark. NoMark removes supported invisible Unicode and can optionally rewrite statistical token patterns while protecting facts such as numbers, links, email addresses, quotes and code.

Is NoMark an AI text watermark detector?

NoMark detects exact hidden Unicode, zero-width characters, directional controls and mixed-script lookalikes. Those findings are not proof of AI authorship. Statistical text watermarks cannot be confirmed by scanning Unicode alone.

Can NoMark remove C2PA Content Credentials and EXIF data from an AI image?

NoMark rebuilds JPEG, PNG and WebP images in your browser to remove common file metadata including EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC and C2PA containers. It does not remove visible logos or robust watermarks encoded into image pixels, such as SynthID-style signals.

Is this AI watermark remover free and private?

Yes. NoMark is free and requires no account. Exact Unicode scanning and image processing happen on your device. The optional text rewrite runs only after you click the removal button and uses a fast edge model.

常见问题解答

NoMark 删除了什么——以及没有删除什么。

How do I remove hidden watermarks from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini text?

将文本粘贴到 NoMark 中，查看字符报告，然后选择“删除 AI 水印”。 NoMark 删除了受支持的不可见 Unicode，并且可以选择重写统计标记模式，同时保护数字、链接、电子邮件地址、引用和代码等事实。

Is NoMark an AI text watermark detector?

NoMark 可检测精确的隐藏 Unicode、零宽度字符、方向控制和混合脚本相似字符。 这些发现并不能证明人工智能的作者身份。 统计文本水印无法仅通过扫描Unicode来确认。

Can NoMark remove C2PA Content Credentials and EXIF data from an AI image?

NoMark 在浏览器中重建 JPEG、PNG 和 WebP 图像，以删除常见文件元数据，包括 EXIF、GPS、XMP、IPTC 和 C2PA 容器。 它不会删除编码到图像像素中的可见徽标或强大的水印，例如 SynthID 样式信号。

Is this AI watermark remover free and private?

是的。 NoMark 是免费的，不需要帐户。 精确的 Unicode 扫描和图像处理发生在您的设备上。 可选的文本重写仅在您单击删除按钮并使用快速边缘模型后运行。
